name: catalogmodelinfo-simple
description: Simple ladder for the catalogModelInfo flag (pro tier, default true): a bundled CC0 GLB catalog card's title tooltip carries its size + licence + attribution only when the flag resolves on. Hidden in Simple, present in Pro; searches for 'Book set' (a generatedCatalog CC0/Poly Haven decor item with license+attribution set) so modelInfoText() has something to render.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: card-visible
steps.failMessage: 'Book set' catalog card did not appear in search results

steps.name: verify-no-tooltip-in-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const card = [...document.querySelectorAll('.card-grid .cat-card')].find(c => c.getAttribute('aria-label')?.includes('Book set')); if (!card) throw new Error('Book set card not found'); const title = card.getAttribute('title'); if (title) throw new Error('Card carries a model-info title in Simple mode (catalogModelInfo is pro-tier, should be forced off): ' + title); })()

steps.name: verify-tooltip-present-in-pro
steps.eval: (function(){ const card = [...document.querySelectorAll('.card-grid .cat-card')].find(c => c.getAttribute('aria-label')?.includes('Book set')); if (!card) throw new Error('Book set card not found in Pro mode'); const title = card.getAttribute('title'); if (!title) throw new Error('No title attribute on the card in Pro mode — catalogModelInfo tooltip missing'); if (!title.includes('CC0') || !title.includes('Poly Haven')) throw new Error('Title does not contain expected licence/attribution: ' + title); window.__cardTitle = title; })()

steps.name: verify-tooltip-hidden-when-forced-off
steps.eval: (function(){ const card = [...document.querySelectorAll('.card-grid .cat-card')].find(c => c.getAttribute('aria-label')?.includes('Book set')); if (!card) throw new Error('Book set card not found'); const title = card.getAttribute('title'); if (title) throw new Error('Title still present after setFeatureFlag(catalogModelInfo,false): ' + title); })()

steps.name: verify-tooltip-restored
steps.eval: (function(){ const card = [...document.querySelectorAll('.card-grid .cat-card')].find(c => c.getAttribute('aria-label')?.includes('Book set')); const title = card && card.getAttribute('title'); if (!title) throw new Error('Title did not come back after restoring the flag'); })()

steps.name: verify-hidden-again-in-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const card = [...document.querySelectorAll('.card-grid .cat-card')].find(c => c.getAttribute('aria-label')?.includes('Book set')); if (!card) throw new Error('Book set card not found'); const title = card.getAttribute('title'); if (title) throw new Error('Title present again after switching back to Simple: ' + title); })()
